metrics.note: Reliability computed on the LEAGUE-SEASON-CENTERED value (era-drift removed), matching PER-07 convention. Excluded dimensions have YoY 95% CI upper bound at or below zero -- the ONE admissible reliability-based exclusion for a cell input, per the task predeclaration. An interval crossing zero on the EXPERIMENT itself (later, at screening time) is never grounds for exclusion; this is a distinct, narrower gate applied only to whether a dimension counts as a persistent trait at all.
